title: FATHER GOD, THANK YOU FOR THE GIFT OF A NEW DAY | APOSTLE JOSHUA SELMAN
paragraphs: I want you to lift up your hands wherever you are in your room, in your office, in your car. And I want you to begin to worship the ancient of days. I want you to worship the one who was and is and is to come. The one who holds time in his hands. The one who spoke and the walls came into being. Worship him. Magnify his holy name. Father, we thank you. We thank you for the gift of a new day. We thank you that we did not arrive at this moment by accident.

We thank you that while many went to sleep and never woke up, while many took their last breath in the night season, you in your infinite mercy, in your sovereign grace, you preserved our lives. You sustained our breath. You kept our hearts beating. Father, we are here not because we are better, not because we deserve it, but because of your mercy that is new every morning. Great is your faithfulness, oh God. Great is your faithfulness. So we lift our voices and we say thank you.

We say thank you for another opportunity. Thank you for another chance to fulfill purpose. Thank you for another day to walk in your presence. Thank you for another day to advance your kingdom. Thank you father. Thank you Lord. Thank you Holy Spirit. Now I want you to understand something very critical. I want you to understand the spiritual significance of what it means to receive a new day from the hands of the almighty. You see in the realm of the spirit time is a currency. Time is a divine investment.

God does not give you days carelessly. He does not give you mornings accidentally. Every sunrise is a prophetic statement. Every new day is a divine decree that says your assignment is not yet complete. Your purpose has not been fully manifested. There is more that I have invested in you that must come forth. The Bible says in Lamentations 3:22 and 23, "It is of the Lord's mercies that we are not consumed because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning. Great is thy faithfulness." Did you see that?

New every morning. Not recycled mercy. Not yesterday's compassion, fresh mercy, fresh compassion, fresh grace for this very day. You see, when you woke up this morning, you did not wake up with yesterday's grace. You woke up with today's grace. And the grace that God has given you for today is specifically designed, specifically fashioned, specifically ordained for the challenges you will face today, for the opportunities you will encounter today, for the assignments you must fulfill today.

This is why you cannot leave today with yesterday's revelation. This is why you cannot face today's battles with yesterday's strategies. You need fresh fire. You need fresh oil. You need fresh grace. And so I stand before you in the supernatural to declare that the Lord wants to do something unusual in your life through this message. He wants to open your eyes to see that every new day is a prophetic opportunity. Every morning you open your eyes is heaven saying I still believe in you.

I still have confidence in your ability to carry what I have placed inside of you. I am giving you another chance, another opportunity to get it right. You know many people wake up and they treat the morning like it is common. They treat the new day like it is ordinary. They open their eyes, they look at their phone, they scroll through social media, they rush into the activities of the day without pausing to recognize that they have just experienced a miracle. You waking up this morning was a miracle.

The fact that your heart is still beating is a miracle. The fact that your lungs are still drawing breath is a miracle. The fact that your mind is still sound is a miracle. There are people who went to sleep in expensive beds in air conditioned rooms with all the medical care in the world and they never woke up. But you, you who may be struggling financially, you who may be facing challenges, you who may be dealing with difficulties, you opened your eyes. Why? Because God has mercy on you.

Because God has a purpose for you. Because God has a plan for your life that must come to pass. So when you say, "Father, thank you for the gift of a new day." You are not just saying a religious phrase. You are making a prophetic declaration. You are acknowledging the sovereignty of God. You are recognizing that your life is not in your own hands, but in the hands of the one who numbers your days. The Bible says in Psalm 90:12, "So teach us to number our days that we may apply our hearts onto wisdom."

To number your days means to recognize the value of time. It means to understand that every day is a gift that must be stewarded. It means to realize that you cannot waste today because today will never come again. Today is a unique moment in eternity. Today is a divine opportunity that has never existed before and will never exist again. What you do with today matters. How you spend today matters. How you invest today matters. And the enemy knows this. Oh, the adversary understands the value of time.

This is why one of his primary strategies is to get you to waste your days. He wants you to sleep through your mornings. He wants you to spend your time on things that do not matter. He wants you to invest your energy in pursuits that have no eternal value. Because he knows that if he can get you to waste your time, he has successfully aborted your destiny. If he can get you to mismanage your days, he has effectively stolen your future. But I came to tell you that the Lord is giving you a fresh perspective today.

The Lord is opening your eyes to see that every new day is a battlefield. Every morning is a warfare arena. And the first battle you must win is the battle of how you begin your day. How you start your morning determines how you will end your day. How you approach the first hour determines how you will navigate the remaining hours. This is why the Bible says in Psalm 5:3, "My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, oh Lord. In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee and will look up." Did you see that?

In the morning, not in the afternoon when you are already overwhelmed. Not in the evening when you're already exhausted. In the morning when your mind is fresh, when your spirit is sensitive, when the distractions of the day have not yet crowded your consciousness. The morning is a prophetic time. The morning is when heaven is most accessible. The morning is when the atmosphere is most conducive for divine encounter. This is why throughout scripture, you see that God meets with his people in the morning.

Abraham rose up early in the morning to commune with God. Moses went up to the mountain early in the morning to receive the commandments. Jesus, our perfect example, rose up early in the morning while it was yet dark and went out to a solitary place to pray. Why? Because they understood that if you win the morning, you win the day. If you consecrate the morning, you consecrate the day. If you give God the first fruits of your time, he will sanctify the remainder of your time. This is not just a religious ritual.

This is a spiritual principle that has governed the lives of every great man and woman of God throughout history. So when you wake up and you say, "Father, thank you for the gift of a new day, you must follow that thanksgiving with consecration." You must dedicate that day back to God. You must say, "Lord, this day that you have given me, I give it back to you. I consecrate it unto you. I dedicate every hour, every moment, every second to your glory. Let this day count for eternity.

Let this day advance your kingdom. Let this day manifest your purposes. You see, there is a difference between just living and living with intentionality. There is a difference between merely existing and walking in purpose. Many people are alive but they are not truly living. They are breathing but they are not fulfilling destiny. They are occupying space but they are not manifesting the divine assignment that heaven has ordained for their lives. But God is raising up a generation in this hour.

A generation that will not waste their days. A generation that will not squander their time. A generation that understands that every day is a divine investment that must yield eternal dividends. And you are part of that generation. You are part of that company. You are part of that remnant that God is raising up to walk in radical intentionality to live with prophetic focus to spend your days in a manner that brings glory to the name of the most high God. Now I want to pray with you.

I want to lead you in a prayer of consecration. I want you to lift up your hands. I want you to open your mouth and I want you to pray with me in the spirit. Father, we come before you in the mighty name of Jesus. We come before you with hearts full of gratitude, with spirits overflowing with thanksgiving. Lord, we acknowledge that we are standing in this moment not by our power, not by our might, not by our wisdom, but by your mercy. We thank you, Father. We thank you for the gift of a new day.

We thank you that you have counted us worthy to see another morning. We thank you that you have preserved our lives through the dangers of the night season. Lord, we declare that we will not take this gift for granted. We declare that we will not waste this day. We declare that we will maximize every moment, steward every hour, and invest every second for your glory. Father, we consecrate this day unto you. We give it back to you. We say that this day belongs to you.

Every conversation we have today, let it be divinely orchestrated. Every person we meet today, let it be a divine appointment. Every activity we engage in today, let it be aligned with your perfect will. Lord, we pray that you will give us the grace to live with intentionality. Give us the wisdom to discern the times and the seasons. Give us the spiritual sensitivity to recognize the opportunities you are placing before us.

Father, do not let us be people who are busy but unfruitful, active but unproductive, moving but not making progress. Let every step we take today be ordered by you. Let every decision we make today be guided by your spirit. And father, we pray for those who are listening to this message right now, wherever they are in the world. Some are facing challenges. Some are dealing with difficulties. Some are wrestling with fears and anxieties about what this day will bring. Lord, we speak peace into their hearts.

We speak courage into their spirits. We declare that they will not face this day alone. You are with them. You are for them. You will never leave them nor forsake them. We decree and declare that as they step into this day, they step into divine favor. As they walk through this day, they walk under an open heaven. As they navigate this day, they navigate with supernatural wisdom and divine guidance. Every trap the enemy has set for them today, we command it to be exposed and destroyed in the name of Jesus.

Every ambush the adversary has planned for them today, we command it to backfire in the name of Jesus. Every weapon that has been fashioned against them today, we declare that it shall not prosper in the name of Jesus. Lord, we cover them with the blood of Jesus. We surround them with your angels. We release upon them the fullness of your presence, the totality of your power, the completeness of your protection. Let this day be a day of victory for them. Let this day be a day of breakthrough for them.

Let this day be a day of manifestation for them. Father, we pray that as the sun sets tonight, they will be able to look back and say, "This was a day that the Lord made. This was a day that counted for eternity. This was a day that advanced the kingdom. This was a day that brought glory to your name. We pray this in the mighty name of Jesus. Now I want you to understand something else that is very crucial. When we talk about the gift of a new day, we must understand that this gift comes with divine assignments.

God does not give you days just so you can exist. He gives you days so you can execute. He gives you mornings so you can manifest. He gives you time so you can fulfill purpose. You see, before you were born, before you took your first breath, before your parents even thought about having you, God had already prepared works for you to walk in. The Bible says in Ephesians 2:10, "For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus unto good works, which God hath before ordained that we should walk in them."

Did you catch that? before ordained, pre-planned, pre-arranged, predetermined. This means that there are specific assignments that have your name on them. There are specific works that can only be done by you. There are specific people that can only be touched by you. There are specific problems that can only be solved by you. And every day that God gives you is an opportunity to walk in those pre-ordained works. Every morning that you wake up is an invitation to step into those divine assignments.

But here is what many people do not understand. These assignments are time sensitive. They have expiration dates. They have divine moments. They have prophetic windows. And if you miss the timing, you can miss the assignment. If you waste the day, you can forfeit the opportunity. If you are not spiritually alert, you can walk right past the very thing that God has ordained for you to do. This is why Jesus said in John chapter 9:4, I must walk the works of him that sent me while it is day.

The night cometh when no man can walk. Did you see the urgency? I must walk while it is day. Jesus understood that time was limited. He understood that he had a specific window to fulfill his assignment. He understood that he could not afford to waste a single moment, a single hour, a single day. And if Jesus who was God in flesh, who had all power, who had all authority, if he recognized the importance of maximizing his time, how much more should we?

If he felt the urgency to walk while it was day, how much more should we? If he understood that the night was coming when no man can walk, how much more should we understand that our time on earth is limited? Our days are numbered. Our opportunities are finite. This is why I'm pressing you today. This is why I'm challenging you today. This is why I'm provoking you today. You cannot afford to waste another day. You cannot afford to sleep through another morning.

You cannot afford to live below the level of what God has called you to. You must wake up. You must rise up. You must step into the fullness of what God has ordained for your life. There are people waiting for you to fulfill your assignment. There are lives that will not be touched until you walk in your purpose. There are problems that will not be solved until you step into your divine mandate. There are breakthroughs that are locked up in heaven waiting for you to do what God has called you to do.

And every day that you waste, every morning that you mismanage, every hour that you squander is a delay in the manifestation of what God wants to do through you. But I hear the spirit of the Lord saying that the season of delay is over. I hear the spirit of the Lord saying that the time of procrastination has ended. I hear the spirit of the Lord saying that today is the day of acceleration. Today is the day of activation. Today is the day of manifestation.

God is giving you this new day with a fresh anointing with a fresh grace with a fresh mandate. He's saying this is not just another day. This is a prophetic day. This is a day of divine opportunity. This is a day when heaven is aligning circumstances, orchestrating events, and arranging encounters to position you for breakthrough. But you must be spiritually alert. You must be prayerfully engaged. You must be intentionally focused. Let me tell you something that will revolutionize your life.

Every person you meet today is a divine appointment. Every conversation you have today is a prophetic encounter. Every situation you face today is a platform for God to demonstrate his power. But you will miss it if you are not paying attention. You will walk right past it if you are not spiritually sensitive. You will forfeit it if you are not intentionally looking for what God is doing. This is why you must begin your day with prayer. This is why you must start your morning with worship.

This is why you must consecrate the first fruits of your time to seeking the face of God. Because when you do that, God opens your eyes. He gives you spiritual discernment. He grants you prophetic insight. He enables you to see what others cannot see, to hear what others cannot hear, to perceive what others cannot perceive. And when you can see what God is doing, when you can hear what God is saying, when you can perceive where God is moving, then you can position yourself to be part of what he's doing.

You can align yourself with his purposes. You can cooperate with his plans. And when you do that, you step into a dimension of grace, a dimension of favor, a dimension of supernatural blessing that defies natural explanation. You see, this is the secret of every successful person in the kingdom. This is the testimony of every effective believer throughout scripture. There were people who understood divine timing. There were people who recognized prophetic moments.

There were people who knew how to discern when God was moving and how to position themselves to be part of what he was doing. Abraham knew when to leave home. Moses knew when to confront Pharaoh. Joshua knew when to cross the Jordan. David knew when to fight Goliath. Esther knew when to go before the king. They were not just spiritual people. They were not just prayerful people. They were people who understood timing. They were people who could discern seasons.

There were people who knew how to recognize when heaven was opening doors and how to walk through those doors before they closed. And this is what God wants to give you today. He wants to give you the gift of spiritual discernment. He wants to give you the ability to recognize divine opportunities. He wants to give you the wisdom to know when to move, when to speak, when to act, when to step forward in faith. But this gift does not come automatically. It comes through intimacy with God.

It comes through spending time in his presence. It comes through developing spiritual sensitivity. It comes through prioritizing the secret place. It comes through making prayer a lifestyle, not just a religious activity. It comes through studying the word, not just reading it. It comes through worshiing in spirit and in truth. Not just singing songs. So I am calling you today to a higher level of consecration. I am calling you to a deeper level of commitment.
I am calling you to a more intense level of spiritual discipline. Not because I want to burden you with religious activities.

Not because I want to put you under legalistic bondage, but because I know that the dimension of glory that God wants to take you to, the level of impact that God wants you to have, the measure of influence that God wants to give you, it will require a level of spiritual maturity, a level of prophetic sensitivity, a level of divine alignment that only comes through intentional pursuit of his presence. Now, let me pray for you again. Lift up your hands. Open your mouth. Let's pray together.

Father, in the name of Jesus, we come before your throne of grace. Lord, we ask that you will baptize us aresh with the spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of you. Open the eyes of our understanding. Enlighten the eyes of our hearts. Give us the ability to see what you are doing, to hear what you are saying, to perceive where you are moving. Lord, we ask for divine discernment. We ask for prophetic insight. We ask for spiritual sensitivity. Teach us to number our days.

Teach us to recognize divine opportunities. Teach us to maximize every moment you give us. Father, do not let us be people who are spiritually dull, prophetically blind or divinely insensitive. Sharpen our spirits, quicken our hearts, open our ears. And Lord, we pray that as we step into this day, you will go before us, order our steps, direct our paths, lead us in the way that we should go, bring us into contact with the people we are supposed to meet, position us in the places where we are supposed to be.

Open doors that no man can shut. Close doors that we should not walk through. Father, let this be a day of divine appointments. Let this be a day of prophetic encounters. Let this be a day of supernatural breakthroughs. We decree that we will not waste this day. We decree that we will maximize this day. We decree that this day will count for eternity. We'll advance the kingdom and will bring glory to your name. We thank you for the gift of this new day. We honor you for your faithfulness.

We worship you for your mercy and we commit ourselves aresh to walking in your purposes all the days of our lives. In Jesus mighty name we pray. Amen and amen. Glory to God. I want you to shout a hallelujah. Praise to the king of glory. Somebody lift up your voice and magnify his name. You know, as I am ministering to you today, I am reminded of Psalm 118:4, where the scripture says, "This is the day which the Lord hath made. We will rejoice and be glad in it."

This is one of the most profound declarations in scripture. Yet many people quote it without understanding the depth of what they are saying. When the psalmist says, "This is the day which the Lord had made," he's making a declaration of divine sovereignty. He's acknowledging that this day did not happen by chance. This day did not occur by accident. This day did not come into being through random cosmic forces. No, this day is a product of divine decree. This day is a result of God's sovereign will.

This day is a manifestation of heaven's purposes. Before the foundation of the world, God looked down through the corridors of time and he saw this very day. He saw this very moment. He saw you listening to this message. He saw you receiving this word and he ordained it. He planned it. He purposed it. This is the day which the Lord has made. And because the Lord made it, this day has divine potential. This day has prophetic possibilities. This day has supernatural opportunities. This day is pregnant with miracles.

This day is loaded with breakthroughs. This day is saturated with the presence and power of the almighty God. But here is what you must understand. The fact that the day is filled with divine potential does not mean that potential will automatically manifest. The fact that the day has prophetic possibilities does not mean those possibilities will automatically materialize. The fact that the day is pregnant with breakthroughs does not mean those breakthroughs will automatically be birthed.

No, you have a role to play. You have a responsibility to fulfill. You have a part to perform. This is why the psalmist did not stop at saying this is the day which the Lord hath made. He continued and said we will rejoice and be glad in it. Do you see that? We will. It is a declaration of intentionality. It is a statement of deliberate choice. It is an expression of active participation. The psalist is saying, "Yes, God has made this day, but we will determine how we respond to this day.

We will choose how we approach this day. We will decide what we do with this day. You can have a day that is full of divine potential and waste it. You can have a morning that is loaded with prophetic possibilities and squander it. You can have 24 hours that are saturated with supernatural opportunities and miss them. It all depends on your response. It all depends on your attitude. It all depends on your level of spiritual engagement. This is why thanksgiving is so important. This is why gratitude is so powerful.

This is why worship is so essential. When you wake up in the morning and you say, "Father, thank you for the gift of a new day." You are not just being polite. You are not just being religious. You are positioning yourself to receive what God has placed in that day. You are aligning yourself with the divine potential of that day. You are opening yourself up to the prophetic possibilities of that day. Thanksgiving is a spiritual key. Gratitude is a prophetic weapon. Worship is a dimension of warfare.

When you thank God, you are acknowledging his sovereignty. When you worship God, you are declaring his lordship. When you praise God, you are activating his power. And when you do these things at the beginning of your day, you are setting the spiritual atmosphere for that day. You are establishing the prophetic frequency for that day. you are releasing the divine flow for that day. This is why the enemy fights so hard to keep you from praying in the morning.

This is why the adversary works over time to make you too busy to worship in the morning. This is why demonic forces conspire to fill your mornings with distractions, with emergencies, with crisis, with urgent but unimportant matters. Because they know that if they can steal your morning, they have stolen your day. If they can rob you of the first hour, they have robbed you of the next 23 hours. But I came to tell you today that you must be violent about protecting your mornings.

You must be militant about guarding your first hours. You must be aggressive about prioritizing your time with God. The Bible says the kingdom of heaven suffers violence and the violent take it by force. You cannot be passive about this. You cannot be casual about this. You cannot be lukewarm about this. You must fight for your mornings. You must war for your prayer time. You must contend for your worship moments. Set your alarm. Wake up early. Turn off your phone. Lock your door. Find a place. Create a space.

Whatever it takes, make it happen. Because your morning time with God is not optional. It is not a luxury. It is not something you do if you have extra time. No, it is a necessity. It is a priority. It is a non-negotiable. It is the most important appointment of your day. You can reschedule a meeting with a client. You can postpone a conversation with a friend. You can delay a business transaction. But you cannot reschedule your appointment with God. You cannot postpone your time in his presence.

You cannot delay your moment of consecration because if you do, you will pay for it for the rest of the day. Now I want to shift the atmosphere. I want to take you into a dimension of prophetic declaration. I want you to stand up wherever you are. I want you to lift up your voice. I want you to decree and declare the word of the Lord over your life, over this day, over your future. Open your mouth and declare with me, I decree and declare that this is my day. This is a day that the Lord has made for me.

This day is filled with divine appointments. This day is loaded with prophetic encounters. This day is saturated with supernatural breakthroughs. I will not waste this day. I will not squander this day. I will maximize this day for the glory of God. I declare that every step I take today is ordered by the Lord. Every conversation I have today is divinely orchestrated. Every decision I make today is guided by the Holy Spirit. I will walk in wisdom. I will operate in discernment. I will move in divine timing.

I decree that every plan the enemy has against me today is canled. Every trap he has set for me is destroyed. Every weapon he has fashioned against me shall not prosper. No evil shall befall me. No plague shall come near my dwelling. For the Lord is my refuge. The most high is my habitation. I declare that today is a day of favor. Today is a day of breakthrough. Today is a day of manifestation. What I have been praying for shall come to pass. What I have been believing God for shall materialize.

What heaven has promised me shall be fulfilled. I decree that I am covered by the blood of Jesus. I am surrounded by the angels of God. I am protected by the power of the Holy Spirit. No weapon formed against me shall prosper. Every tongue that rises against me in judgment shall be condemned. This is my heritage as a servant of the Lord. I declare that I will end this day in victory. I will end this day in thanksgiving. I will end this day with a testimony.

When the sun sets today, I will look back and say, "This was a good day. This was a productive day. This was a day that counted for eternity. This was a day that brought glory to the name of Jesus. In the mighty name of Jesus, I have prayed. Glory to God. Hallelujah. Let somebody shout a praise to the King of glory." Now as I begin to bring this ministration to a close, I want to leave you with this final charge, I want to impress upon your heart the weight of what we have been discussing.

The gift of a new day is not something to be taken lightly. It is not something to be received casually. It is not something to be treated carelessly. It is a sacred trust. It is a divine stewardship. It is a holy responsibility. God has given you this day and one day you will stand before him and give an account for what you did with it. The Bible says in Romans chapter 14:12, "So then every one of us shall give account of himself to God." Did you hear that? Every one of us, you will give an account.

I will give an account. We will all stand before the judgment seat of Christ. An answer for how we spent our time, how we invested our days, how we stewarded the gift of life that he gave us. This should bring a holy soiety to our hearts. This should produce a sacred seriousness in our spirits. This should cause us to evaluate how we are living, how we are spending our time, how we are using our days. Are we living with eternity in view? Are we making decisions with heaven in mind?

Are we investing our time in things that will matter a thousand years from now? Or are we wasting our lives on trivial pursuits? Are we squandering our days on temporary pleasures? Are we spending our time on things that have no eternal value? These are questions we must honestly ask ourselves. These are issues we must seriously confront. These are matters we must prayerfully consider.

And if you find that you have been wasting your days, if you discover that you have been mismanaging your time, if you realize that you have not been living with the intentionality that God requires, then today is your day of reset. Today is your moment of realignment. Today is your opportunity for a fresh start. The beauty of the gift of a new day is that it represents God's mercy. It represents his grace. It represents his willingness to give you another chance.

No matter how you live yesterday, today is a new opportunity. No matter how you wasted last week, this week can be different. No matter how you squandered last year, this year can be a year of redemption. God is not holding your past against you. He's not condemning you for your failures. He's not rejecting you because of your mistakes. No, he's giving you this new day as proof that he still believes in you. He still has confidence in you. He still has plans for you. He still has purposes for you.

So receive this day with gratitude. Embrace this day with thanksgiving. Approach this day with intentionality and determine in your heart that from this day forward, you will live differently. You will pray differently. You will walk differently. You will invest your time differently. You will steward your days differently. Make a decision today that you will not live below the level of what God has called you to. Make a commitment today that you will not waste another day, another hour, another moment.

Make a covenant with God today that your life will count. Your days will matter. Your time will produce eternal fruit. Father, we thank you one more time for the gift of a new day. We thank you that your mercies are new every morning. We thank you that your faithfulness extends to every generation. Lord, help us to live with intentionality. Help us to walk with purpose. Help us to spend our days in a manner that brings glory to your name. We love you. We honor you. We worship you in Jesus mighty name. Amen.
God bless you. Now go and make this day
practice: Thank God for something specific enough that only you could name it: a familiar laugh, a meal someone saved, or a message that arrived in time. Who else deserves your thanks?
